Deep in the Wailing Mountains, in a valley beneath the Ruined City, the ancient Order of the Oyo has for centuries practiced its rites of holy reverie, communing with the spirit realm in grand festivals of drink. Born to a mother's flesh by a Celestial father, the youth known as Mangix was the first to grow up with the talents of both lineages. He trained with the greatest aesthetes of the Order, eventually earning, through diligent drunkenness, the right to challenge for the title of Brewmaster, that appellation most honored among the contemplative malt-brewing sect.

As much drinking competition as mortal combat, Mangix for nine days drank and fought the elder master. For nine nights they stumbled and whirled, chugged and struck, until at last the elder warrior collapsed into a drunken stupor, and a new Brewmaster was named. Now the new, young Brewmaster calls upon the strength of his Oyo forebears to speed his staff. When using magic, it is to his spirit ancestors that he turns. Like all Brewmasters before him, he was sent out from his people with a single mission. He wanders the land, striving toward enlightenment through drink, searching for the answer to the ancient spiritual schism. Hoping to think the single thought that will unite the spirit and physical planes again.

Drenches enemy units within the radius with a debuff upon cast, then rolls the whole barrel toward the area-targeted direction.

The barrel damages and applies debuff to all enemy units the barrel collides with on its way.

Upon reaching the impact location, the barrel explodes, damaging and drenching enemy units within the radius with the same debuff.
The debuff applied causes enemy units to move slower, and they are ignited upon taking any spell damage instances.
Anytime an enemy unit is ignited, the debuff duration is increased.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* The [[toggle]] component has the following properties:
** Not affected by {{M|silence}} sources.
** Does not interrupt Brewmaster's {{M|channeling}} abilities.
** Does not break {{M|invisibility}} sources.
** Switch stances as follows:
*** {{BrawlerStance|Earth}} {{to}} {{BrawlerStance|Storm}} {{to}} {{BrawlerStance|Fire}} {{to}} {{BrawlerStance|Earth}}
*** {{Symbol|fx|v}}
**** The ability effects around Brewmaster indicate the current stance he is in.

* Grants each {{A|Brewmaster|Primal Split|text=Brewlings}} their respective corresponding stances respectively as an additional passive ability in the following ability slots:
** For {{U|Earth Brewling}} and {{U|Storm Brewling}}, the {{Spellslot|4|5}}.
** For {{U|Fire Brewling}}, the {{Spellslot|3|4}}.

* {{cf|Earth Stance}}
** Grants flat {{M|bonus armor}}.
** Stacks multiplicatively with other {{M|magic resistance}} sources.

* {{cf|Storm Stance}}
** {{Symbol|Evasion}}
*** The evasion proc is determined the attack projectile impact, and uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#var:Drunken Brawler type4 value1}}|tal={{#var:Drunken Brawler type4 value1 tal}}}}.
*** [[Evasion#Stacking|Stacks]] diminishingly with other evasion sources.

* {{cf|Fire Stance}}
** {{Symbol|Critical Strike}}
*** The [[critical strike]] proc is determined during the unit's {{M|attack point}} and uses {{M|pseudo-random distribution}} {{Proc|{{#var:Drunken Brawler type5 value2}}}}.
*** The proc chance of multiple sources stack.
**** However, when multiple critical strike sources proc simutaneously, the higher critical factor takes precedence.
*** When {{A|Brewmaster|Drunken Brawler|text=Brewed Up!}} critical strike damage isn't amplified.
<hr>
* {{cf|aghnotes}} Grants all {{A|Brewmaster|Primal Split|text=Brewlings}} brew-up ability bonuses corresponding to the current ability level.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_brewmaster
data.bio_loc:
Deep in the Wailing Mountains, in a valley beneath the Ruined City, the ancient Order of the Oyo has for centuries practiced its rites of holy reverie, communing with the spirit realm in grand festivals of drink. Born to a mother's flesh by a Celestial father, the youth known as Mangix was the first to grow up with the talents of both lineages. He trained with the greatest aesthetes of the Order, eventually earning, through diligent drunkenness, the right to challenge for the title of Brewmaster, that appellation most honored among the contemplative malt-brewing sect.

As much drinking competition as mortal combat, Mangix for nine days drank and fought the elder master. For nine nights they stumbled and whirled, chugged and struck, until at last the elder warrior collapsed into a drunken stupor, and a new Brewmaster was named. Now the new, young Brewmaster calls upon the strength of his Oyo forebears to speed his staff. When using magic, it is to his spirit ancestors that he turns. Like all Brewmasters before him, he was sent out from his people with a single mission. He wanders the land, striving toward enlightenment through drink, searching for the answer to the ancient spiritual schism. Hoping to think the single thought that will unite the spirit and physical planes again.
data.hype_loc: A fearsome fighter in any situation, Brewmaster can turn the tide of battle by splitting into three elemental spirits, each with their own unique abilities. When not divided, he brings drunken chaos to his foes with slowing claps and powerful swings of his staff.
data.npe_desc_loc: Splits into four elemental spirits with unique abilities

abilities.name: brewmaster_thunder_clap
abilities.desc_loc: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.
abilities.lore_loc: A slam of Mangix' mighty keg starts the festivities.

abilities.name: brewmaster_cinder_brew
abilities.desc_loc:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed. If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by %extra_duration%s and causing them to take damage over time.
abilities.lore_loc: The Order of the Oyo's solution to all problems - another round!
facets_loc: Cinder Brew is now a rolling barrel of ale that drenches enemies in its path and explodes at the end.

abilities.name: brewmaster_drunken_brawler
abilities.desc_loc:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by %brewed_up_bonus%%% for %brewed_up_duration%s. If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by %brewed_up_duration_extend%s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for %hangover_time%s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
abilities.lore_loc: When Mangix won his title as the Brewmaster of the Order of Oyo, he also claimed his place in the mastery of inebriation.
notes_loc: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

abilities.name: brewmaster_liquid_courage
abilities.desc_loc: When Brewmaster drops below %min_health_threshold%%% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every %speed_toggle_time%s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at %max_health_threshold%%% Health.
abilities.shard_loc:
Toss a strong drink to a teammate or drink it yourself, activating the maximum power effect of Liquid Courage and granting %max_hp_regen%%% Max HP Regen per second.

Lasts %drink_duration% seconds.

abilities.name: brewmaster_primal_split
abilities.desc_loc: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
abilities.lore_loc: It isn't clear whether Mangix is consciously aware of his potent bond with nature, as it often occurs in the midst of a drunken stupor.
notes_loc: The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
The Fire Element has phased movement.
When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.
abilities.scepter_loc:
Primal Split gains %scepter_bonus_levels% max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.

Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.
